title: racoon AI agent profile (RFC 0005 "provpaws")
description: Tool-neutral description of an AI-assisted setup: which harness, which roles, which model per role. Stored as TOML at .provenance/profiles/<id>/r<N>.toml. A revision file is immutable once merged; any change creates r<N+1>.

id.description: Must equal the profile directory name.

revision.description: Must equal N in the file name r<N>.toml.

harness.description: Agent harness (claude-code, opencode, chat, ...). Informational; the spec does not depend on any particular harness.

owner.description: Who maintains this profile and resolves its neutral references (a person or an organisation).

disclosure.description: withheld: model_id is a neutral reference resolved only by the profile owner.
